<MethodEndpoint

  path={'/v1/admin/encryption/keys'}
  context={'endpoint'}
></MethodEndpoint>

Generates a new key, wraps it under the key-encryption key, retires the active key and inserts the new one in one transaction, then reloads the local key ring. The new key does not become active immediately: for up to `ENCRYPTION_KEY_RING_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS` it is reported as `pendingActivation` while the previous key keeps protecting new writes, so every engine process has a chance to learn of it first. Stored onboardings are not rewritten: rotation is lazy, so a row keeps naming the key it was written under and moves onto this one only the next time it is written. The new key carries the automatic-rotation schedule the superseded one had, and the countdown to the next scheduled rotation restarts from this key's creation. Returns only the new key's id — never its material.
